plugin.data_gateway_name_conflict: A DataGateway named '{name}' already exists. Rename it, then install '{slug}' again. Deleting it doesn't free the name, and a deleted DataGateway can't be renamed.
plugin.artifact_checksum_mismatch: The plugin artifact does not have the checksum you gave, so it was not kept. Check that you copied the whole 64-character SHA-256 checksum, and that you chose the right link or file.
plugin.artifact_too_large: The plugin artifact is larger than a plugin artifact may be, so it was not kept. The limit is 100 MiB before it is unpacked.
plugin.artifact_link_refused_invalid_link: This link cannot be used. It must be an http or https address with no username or password in it, and any address it redirects to must be one the server can use too.
plugin.artifact_link_refused_blocked_by_policy: The server's outbound HTTP policy does not allow this link's address, so nothing was downloaded. A server admin may be able to allow the address in the outbound HTTP policy, though some addresses stay blocked whatever it says. You can also download the file and upload it instead.
plugin.artifact_link_refused_redirect_blocked: This link redirects to an address the server's outbound HTTP policy does not allow, so nothing was downloaded. A server admin may be able to allow that address in the outbound HTTP policy, though some addresses stay blocked whatever it says. You can also download the file and upload it instead.
plugin.artifact_link_refused_too_many_redirects: This link redirects too many times, so nothing was downloaded. Use the final address instead.
plugin.artifact_download_failed_upstream_status: The link answered with HTTP status {upstreamStatus} instead of the plugin artifact. Check the link, then try again.
plugin.artifact_download_failed_unreachable: The server could not reach the link. Check the address, and that the site is up, then try again.
plugin.artifact_download_failed_timeout: The download did not finish within 15 minutes, so it was stopped and nothing was kept. Try again, or upload the plugin artifact as a file instead.
plugin.artifact_not_found: No plugin artifact with this checksum is waiting on this server. Check that the checksum is typed correctly. A plugin artifact that is not installed or staged as an update expires seven days after it is posted, and must then be posted again.
plugin.artifact_belongs_to_another_plugin: This plugin artifact is for plugin '{artifactSlug}', not '{slug}'. Check that you chose the right artifact.
plugin.artifact_source: Send a link or a file: exactly one of the two.
plugin.artifact_upload_invalid: The upload is not in the form the server takes, so nothing was kept. Send one plugin artifact, in the field named file, with its checksum in the field named sha256.
plugin.artifact_archive_not_gzip: This file is not a plugin artifact: it is not a gzip-compressed tar archive (a .tgz file). Check that you chose the right file.
plugin.artifact_archive_corrupt: The plugin artifact is damaged and could not be read to the end. Build it again, or send it again in case it was cut off.
plugin.artifact_archive_entry_type: The plugin artifact holds something other than plain files and folders, such as a link or a device file. Plugin artifacts may hold only files and folders.
plugin.artifact_archive_unsafe_path: The plugin artifact holds a file or folder name the server will not unpack. A name is refused if it climbs out of the plugin's folder with .., starts at the root, contains a backslash (as archives made on Windows may), contains a NUL character, is a file whose name ends in a slash, or is too long: each file or folder name may be at most 255 bytes, and each path inside the plugin's folder at most 1,024 bytes. Ask the plugin's author to build it again.
plugin.artifact_archive_top_level: The plugin artifact must hold exactly one top-level folder, with every file inside it.
plugin.artifact_archive_entry_count: The plugin artifact holds more files and folders than a plugin artifact may. The limit is 50,000.
plugin.artifact_archive_extracted_size: The plugin artifact is too large once unpacked. The limit is 512 MiB.
plugin.artifact_archive_required_file: The plugin artifact is missing a required file. Both manifest.json and package.json must sit directly inside the archive's top-level folder.
plugin.artifact_archive_manifest_slug: The plugin artifact's manifest.json is missing, not valid JSON, or has no valid plugin slug.
plugin.artifact_archive_manifest_size: The plugin artifact's manifest.json is larger than a manifest may be. The limit is 1 MiB.
plugin.directory_layout: The files of plugin '{slug}' on the server do not match its record, so the server cannot use them. The server's operator needs to check the plugins directory.
plugin.directory_not_found: The files of plugin '{slug}' are missing from the server. The server's operator needs to check the plugins directory.
plugin.install_permission_collision: Plugin '{slug}' declares permission slugs that already exist
plugin.update_version_conflict: Version '{version}' of plugin '{slug}' is already active
plugin.update_pending_conflict: Plugin '{slug}' already has version '{pendingVersion}' staged — resolve it before staging '{incomingVersion}'
plugin.update_active_artifact_moved: While this update was being staged, plugin '{slug}' changed: another update or a reinstall replaced its active plugin artifact. The active version is now '{activeVersion}'. Stage this update again, so that it is compared with what is active now.
plugin.update_no_pending: Plugin '{slug}' has no staged pending update to resolve
plugin.update_data_gateway_name_conflict: This update makes '{slug}' a data-gateway plugin, and a DataGateway named '{name}' already exists. Rename that DataGateway, then try the update again. Deleting it doesn't free the name, and a deleted DataGateway can't be renamed.
plugin.update_staging_replaced: The staged update for plugin '{slug}' changed since it was shown — review it again before approving or rejecting it
plugin.install_critical_confirmation: This install grants Critical permissions that must be explicitly confirmed — re-enter each listed permission exactly
plugin.update_critical_confirmation: This update grants Critical permissions that must be explicitly confirmed — re-enter each listed permission exactly
plugin.install_static_analysis: Static analysis found forbidden imports — re-enter each listed specifier to accept the risk and install anyway
plugin.update_static_analysis: Static analysis found forbidden imports in the new version — re-enter each listed specifier to accept the risk and proceed
plugin.install_manifest: The manifest for plugin '{slug}' failed validation
plugin.update_manifest: The update manifest for plugin '{slug}' failed validation
plugin.install_unknown_core_permissions: The manifest requests core permissions that do not exist
plugin.update_unknown_core_permissions: The update requests core permissions that do not exist
plugin.stored_manifest_invalid: The stored manifest for plugin '{slug}' is invalid or inconsistent with its installed record — an administrator must investigate
plugin.static_analysis_unavailable: Plugin static analysis is unavailable on this server — installs and updates are refused until an operator resolves the parser installation
plugin.lifecycle_authority: Managing a plugin on this server requires a server admin
plugin.lifecycle_plugin_changed: Plugin '{slug}' changed while your settings were being saved, so they were not saved — reload its settings and save them again
plugin.lifecycle_tombstoned: Plugin '{slug}' was uninstalled — reinstall it to manage it again
plugin.config_invalid: The configuration for plugin '{slug}' does not match its declared schema
plugin.config_schema_unusable: Plugin '{slug}' declares a configuration schema this server cannot evaluate — an administrator must investigate
plugin.presentation_tombstoned: Plugin '{slug}' was uninstalled and has no consent surface
plugin.consent_act_stale: Plugin '{slug}' or one of its permissions changed since this page was loaded. Review its current permissions and answer again.
plugin.consent_act_required_set: Switching on plugin '{slug}' means accepting every permission it requires.
plugin.consent_act_answer: Some answers sent for plugin '{slug}' can't be given here, so nothing was saved. Refresh the page and answer only the questions it shows.
plugin.consent_act_ungrantable: Plugin '{slug}' asks for a permission that can't be granted here, so nothing was saved. Only a new version of the plugin, or a change to how this server defines that permission, can make it grantable.
plugin.consent_act_no_user_scope: Plugin '{slug}' doesn't ask anything of individual users, so there is nothing to switch on for your account.
plugin.consent_act_unit_off: Plugin '{slug}' is switched off here. Switch it on to change its permissions.
plugin.consent_act_locale: '{locale}' is not a language this server supports. Reload the page and answer again.
plugin.unit_authority: Managing this household's plugin enablement requires a household owner or admin
plugin.unit_plugin_tombstoned: Plugin '{slug}' was uninstalled, so it can no longer be switched on or have its permissions changed
plugin.unit_scope: Plugin '{slug}' is {scope}-scoped and has no per-household enablement
plugin.unit_not_enrolled: Plugin '{slug}' has no enablement record for this unit
plugin.unit_config_required: Plugin '{slug}' requires household configuration before it can be enabled — supply a config document with the enable request
plugin.unit_plugin_changed: Plugin '{slug}' changed while your request was in flight — retry to act on the current version
plugin.feature_state_tombstoned: Plugin '{slug}' was uninstalled and has no feature state
plugin.inventory_tombstoned: Plugin '{slug}' was uninstalled — reinstall it to manage it again

database.deadlock: Another change was being applied at the same time. Please retry the request.

not_user_attributable.plugin: Only a user can make this change, not a plugin.
not_user_attributable.external: Only a user can make this change, not an outside system.
not_user_attributable.system: Only a user can make this change, not the server itself.

permission.condition_unevaluable: The server could not check a permission this needs, so nothing was changed. Try again later, and tell the server's operator if it keeps happening.

permission_catalog.entry_not_found: There's no permission called '{slug}' on this server
permission_catalog.entry_not_editable: The permission '{slug}' belongs to a plugin, so it can't be edited here
permission_catalog.edit_empty: Nothing to change. Send a new condition, reason or risk level, or retire or revive the permission
permission_catalog.entry_refused: This change wasn't saved because the permission wouldn't work safely with it. Each problem listed says what to fix
permission_catalog.entry_changed: This permission was changed while your change was being saved. Your change wasn't saved. Load the permission again and try again
permission_catalog.owner_lockout: This change wasn't saved because it would take full control of the server away from the Owner, with no way to get it back
permission_catalog.role_not_found: There's no role called '{name}' on this server
permission_catalog.role_not_editable: The role '{name}' belongs to a plugin, so it can't be edited here
permission_catalog.role_changed: This role was changed while your change was being saved. Your change wasn't saved. Load the role again and try again
permission_catalog.grant_not_found: The role '{name}' doesn't hold the permission '{slug}'
permission_catalog.grant_not_editable: The role '{name}' holds the permission '{slug}' through a plugin, so it can't be changed here
permission_catalog.grant_refused: This change wasn't saved because the roles holding this permission wouldn't work safely with it. Each problem listed says what to fix
permission_catalog.grant_changed: This grant was changed while your change was being saved. Your change wasn't saved. Load the role again and try again
permission_catalog.permission_retired: The permission '{slug}' is retired, so giving it to a role would do nothing. Revive the permission first, then give it to the role
permission_catalog.permission_not_grantable: The permission '{slug}' belongs to a plugin, so which roles hold it can't be changed here
permission_catalog.role_not_judgeable: The role '{name}' isn't one this version of the server can check permissions for, so it can't be given a permission. You can still take permissions away from it
